subject: Hosted API evaluation — quick sandbox walkthrough for NimbleStock

To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: theo@nimblestock.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 08:23:00 +0100
Subject: Request: Hosted API eval + sandbox walkthrough

Hi Diego / Redwood team,

We just completed the self-serve signup and spun up a Hosted API sandbox for a short trial. I’m Morgan (Product) at NimbleStock — our CTO Theo (cc’d) would like a quick walkthrough of the sandbox to validate latency and token costs for a chat-centric workflow.

High level: we want to see a sample chat prompt roundtrip, review batching/throughput options, and confirm the integration path for our serverless stack. We prefer afternoons CET next week (Tue/Wed) but are fairly flexible.

Can someone do a 30-min session focused on the sandbox and a short mutual action plan? Our security team will also want to kick off the questionnaire afterward.

Thanks,
Morgan Lee
Product Lead, NimbleStock
[morgan@nimblestock.com]

Attachment: nimblestock_sandbox_logs.csv (small request logs export)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>

Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 10:10:00 -0800

Hi Morgan — great to meet you, and congrats on spinning up the sandbox. I’m on the SDR team and happy to run a compact walkthrough that focuses on the Hosted API evaluation checklist.

Proposed: 20 minutes (we’ve found 20-min sandbox walk = highest signal + minimal calendar overhead).
Options (all CET):
 - Tue 14 Feb 15:00–15:20
 - Tue 14 Feb 16:30–16:50
 - Wed 15 Feb 14:00–14:20

If none of those work, what windows next week look best for you? I’ve cc’d Irene from OnboardingOps for any sandbox provisioning follow-ups (SSO / test tokens).

Agenda (short):
 - 5m quick intros + priorities
 - 10m demo of your sandbox use case (chat prompt roundtrip, token counts)
 - 5m next steps & mutual action plan

Calendly link if you prefer self-book: https://calendly.com/redwood/diego-20min

cheers,
Diego Fernandez
SDR, Redwood Inference
